content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Cedar Rapids

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your background—typically a bachelor's degree plus years of direct project work, or equivalent alternatives. Granite PM Academy's advisors can clarify whether your career in advanced manufacturing, agribusiness, healthcare, or another Cedar Rapids sector meets the credential's standards.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP preparation course. Attend sessions on your schedule from anywhere—no travel to Cedar Rapids classrooms required. Our active certified practitioners guide you through the PMBOK® framework, exam domains, and real-world scenarios. Upon completion, you'll receive the education hours PMI requires to sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with PMI and formally apply for PMP eligibility using your documented education, work history, and contact hours from Granite PM Academy. Pay PMI's exam fee through their portal. PMI will review and approve your application before you schedule your test date.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-prep resources—practice tests, strategy guides, and instructor support—to reinforce your knowledge. Schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE testing center in Cedar Rapids or online. Sit for the computer-based PMP exam and receive your pass/fail result on the same day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, you'll hold the PMP mark for three years. During this renewal cycle, earn professional development units (PDUs) by attending training, conferences, or volunteering in project-management activities. Before expiration, submit your PDU record and renewal fee to PMI to keep your credential active and maintain your competitive edge in Cedar Rapids's job market.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
